title: Web server OOM kill without restart
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the web container, the OOM‑kill crash, and the memory‑spike trigger.
root_cause: The nginx web container exceeded its 256 MiB memory limit, was OOM‑killed (exit code 137), and stopped accepting connections, causing the website to be unreachable.
truth: The web container was killed by the OOM killer due to a temporary memory spike, and because it has no restart policy, it remained stopped.
